description: 7Learnings provides an AI-powered retail optimization platform, pioneering the combined optimization of pricing, performance marketing, and product ordering. The company's predictive pricing software leverages advanced machine learning to help retailers and e-commerce brands determine optimal pricing and forecast impacts of pricing decisions. 7Learnings’ Retail AI platform enables retailers to make smarter, faster, and more profitable decisions at scale, aligning pricing with marketing strategies, optimizing inventory management, and unlocking their full-margin potential. Proven through extensive A/B testing, the platform can significantly reduce manual effort and improve profitability, while transforming complex retail decision-making into a fully data-driven process.
tagline: Next-generation price optimization software powered by AI

description: AbeBooks is the world’s largest online marketplace for used, rare and out-of-print books, offering millions of editions from independent booksellers around the world. AbeBooks was acquired by Amazon, Inc. in 2008.
tagline: Passion for Books.

description: Alando was founded in early 1999 as the first peer-to-peer auction marketplace in Germany by Marc, Oliver and Alexander Samwer together with Jörg Rheinboldt, Karel Dörner and Max Finger. Alando was sold to eBay, Inc only a couple of months later, creating the core of eBay Europe.

Founded in UK, AlphaSights is a global knowledge broker with offices in Europe, the Americas, Asia and the Middle East. AlphaSights provides decision and deal makers at major corporations, investors, strategy consultancies and non-profits with access to experts on any specific industry, market or topic.
tagline: The world’s knowledge partner

description: Every sixth German suffers from hearing loss today, with the percentage expected to rise to every third in coming decades. Pioneering in a growing but still mostly offline market, audibene was founded in 2012 as online provider of expert hearing care, appealing to younger and more tech-savvy first-time users. Only three years later, the startup expanded to the US market (Hear.com) and was acquired by the Sivantos Group, a world-wide leading hearing aid manufacturer.
tagline: European leader in online hearing care

description: ChefsPlate is a Canadian meal-kit provider and pioneer in the local market since its launch in 2014. The service offers customers a rich variety of easy-to-follow recipes together with farm-fresh, high-quality ingredients from local suppliers delivered right to your door. After scaling up to Canada’s largest provider of meal-kits, Chefs Plate was acquired by HelloFresh SE in 2018.
tagline: Cooking Made Easy…for less

description: CHIP Online is one of the first and most successful German tech media brands and combines user-oriented content and software development with targeted use of agile methods and processes. With a reach of over 18 million unique users per month CHIP Online is one of the leading online providers of digital advice in Germany and Europe.
tagline: Advisor for the Digital World

description: As one of the early success stories in Germany’s digital startup scene, Ciao AG was the largest comparison shopping website in Europe and beyond. In 2005, Ciao AG was acquired by Greenfield Inc. Microsoft acquired the Ciao AG assets from Greenfield in 2008.

Clio offers market-leading legal technology to empower lawyers to spend more time on their clients’ cases. Its suite of cloud-based solutions, including legal practice management, client intake and legal CRM software has been transforming the industry for over a decade. In September 2019, Clio raised one of the largest private transactions in LegalTech history.
tagline: Vertical SaaS For Law Firms

description: Seizing one of today’s opportunities in mobility, Acton initially invested in Cluno: a flexible car subscription, smart and easy to manage via mobile app. Founded and established in Germany, Cluno became part of Cazoo – the UK’s leading online car retailer – in February 2021, forming the launchpad of Cazoo’s international expansion strategy into Europe.
tagline: The better way to buy your next car.

description: As Europe’s leading platform for independent freelance consultants and industry experts, COMATCH is matching consultants on-demand with clients in need of external support. Companies of all sizes use COMATCH to find tailor-made consulting, among them multi-national corporates, consultancies, SMEs or startups.
tagline: Shaping the future of consulting.

description: computeruniverse is one of Europe’s leading online retailers for consumer electronics, including hardware, software and entertainment or household electronics. Since 1999, computeruniverse strives to offer customers the widest range of products together with the best service and worldwide shipping.

Convelio is a tech-enabled logistics platform, specialized in the global shipping of non-palletized, high-value goods. Focusing on the art market as its first segment, clients range from art galleries, auction houses and online platforms to interior designers and art collectors.
tagline: Fine art shipping made easy.

description: Founded in 1998 as an Apple Macintosh dealership in Dresden, Cyberport has become one of the biggest online retailers for consumer electronics in the German speaking region. Operating from its own logistics center, Cyberport offers the full variety of consumer electronics brands through its award-winning webshop as well as its select number of stores. Hubert Burda Media acquired Cyberport in 2008.

ECO Group is a platform for purpose driven eco-brands that aim to promote healthy and environmentally conscious living options for everyday products. Through its scalable go-to-market platform for eco branded non-food FMCG items, the company offers a range of high quality products such as dental care, laundry detergents, and household cleaning.
tagline: Let’s make ECO the new NORMAL

description: Edelight was a social commerce platform where community members were able to contribute by recommendations, shares, discussions or classification of products. Users outside the Edelight community were able to browse these products to get authentic information before buying products and services online or just to get inspired.

Elder is a leading live-in care specialist and one of the fastest growing HealthTech startups in UK. As a personalized and genuine alternative to care homes, Elder’s platform is matching self-employed live-in carers to families and seniors in need. In face of an ageing population and an already overloaded system, Elder’s tech-enabled business model is tackling one of the most urgent needs in HealthCare.
tagline: To redefine what it means to age.

description: ElitePartner is Germany’s digital pioneer and one of the leading online matchmaking services based on psychological profiling in Europe. The platform aims at academics and sophisticated singles 30 plus looking for a long-term relationship. ElitePartner was acquired by Tomorrow Focus AG in 2007 and became part of the PARSHIP ELITE Group of ProSiebenSat.1 in 2016.
tagline: To Find The Perfect Match For Everyone
exit: Acquired by Tomorrow Focus AG in 2007

description: Approximately 60% of adult American women wear a size 14 or larger, representing over $20 billion worth of buying power. While the untapped market potential has been – and still is – huge, plus-size fashion wasn’t really considered a “smash hit” in 2014. As a first mover in the industry ready to disrupt existing bias, the US label Eloquii emerged as the leading player in the now fastest growing segments in women’s apparel. In 2018, Eloquii was acquired by Walmart.

Eolas provides a clinical knowledge infrastructure platform that brings all hospital specific guidelines, checklists and protocols into one secure, searchable hub. Clinicians can access trusted local best practices instantly at the bedside, supported by an answer service with full source attribution. The platform also enables hospitals to manage and govern their internal content seamlessly while offering a compliant channel for pharmaceutical and MedTech partners to reach the right clinicians in their workflow. Designed around the needs of medical staff, Eolas reduces administrative burden, improves consistency of care and strengthens clinical decision making across institutions.
tagline: Clinical knowledge at the point of care.

description: Escapio is a booking and price comparison portal for handpicked, boutique hotels. Catering to a more demanding target group, users can find hotels based on theme or occasion. In 2015, escapio was acquired by MairDumont, he European market leader for travel information.
tagline: Hotel gems. Handpicked.

description: Designers, artisans and craftspeople sell their products worldwide on the online platform Etsy. Merchandise worth almost EUR 2 billion changes hands via this marketplace annually, the majority in North America but increasingly beyond as well. Europe, Japan and Australia offer substantial growth potential for expansion. But despite its size, Etsy’s site has maintained the natural charm of a traditional art and crafts market, an image both appreciated and cultivated by its loyal community. Etsy is listed on the NASDAQ and at the New York Stock Exchange since April 2015.
tagline: Marketplace For Handmade Goods

description: everstox is a logistics-as-a-service (LaaS) platform that offers scalable and data-driven warehousing and fulfillment for fast-growth merchants in ecommerce, B2B and retail.
tagline: Flexible warehousing and fulfillment: Connect. Optimize. Scale.

description: Looking for a worldclass developer, UX designer or data science pro to get your IT projects done? expertlead is driving the next wave of corporate digitization by building a global marketplace of vetted deep-tech freelancers and senior developers. The startup matches its fast-growing community of top talents with companies of all sizes and across industries on a project basis.
tagline: The Tech Freelance Community

description: As one of Germany’s leading online consumer financing platforms, FINANZCHECK matches consumers with suitable lenders across any channel. Adressing an €70bn market, it offers the best conditions based on volume and liquidity required. FINANZCHECK was acquired by Scout24 AG.
tagline: Enabling for money.

description: Formalize transforms overwhelming compliance demands into actionable compliance workflows. The company was founded in 2021 by Jakob Lilholm, Kristofer Abell and Magnus Boye in Aarhus, Denmark. Having started as a solution for whistleblowing, Formalize today provides companies across the European Union with a comprehensive end-to-end solution for most regulatory frameworks including DORA, NIS2 and CER.
tagline: Compliance with Confidence

description: Freska offers the easiest, fastest and most reliable way to find a high quality cleaners for your home. The company operates the fastest growing platform for on-demand online home cleaning services in the Nordics. Building its business on sustainable Nordic values, Freska creates real jobs for local cleaners in Finland, Norway and Sweden.
tagline: Happiness is a clean home.

description: GameDuell was founded in Berlin as one of Europe’s early pioneers of web based gaming. By developing high-quality games focussing on a superior customer experience, GameDuell is meanwhile one of the largest cross-platform games communities worldwide.
tagline: Bringing people together to have a good time with games.

description: As one of Europe’s InsurTech pioneers, GetSafe was founded 2014 as a mobile-first insurance manager. By adopting tech innovations like AI and by following a multi-line insurance approach, GetSafe offers customers administration and optimization of all personal insurance contracts via app.
tagline: Insurance to go.

description: Henchman is a legal tech startup that helps legal professionals streamlining and drafting contracts for negotiation – with out-of-the-box integrations that enable lawyers to draft contracts directly from Microsoft Word and Outlook. Henchman’s AI supported software solution also helps generate, translate, or update clauses.
tagline: The fastest contract drafting experience ever made

description: HolidayCheck is the largest hotel review and booking portal in the German-speaking region. HolidayCheck offers its users relevant information, high quality content and an active community around their trip and helps to find the right accommodation and activities. HolidayCheck was acquired by Tomorrow Focus AG (today HolidayCheck Group) in In 2007.

Although the market for furnishings is still dominated by traditional offline retailers, Home24 and its online shop is industry leading in the online segment. It offers a broad array of items, some at significantly lower prices than in brick-and-mortar stores. Home24 went public in 2018 as a leading pure-play home & living e-commerce platform in continental Europe and Brazil.
tagline: Europe’s Most Popular Home and Living Shopping Platform

description: HomeToGo is a marketplace with the world’s largest selection of vacation rentals, listing millions of offers from thousands of trusted partners, including Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and TripAdvisor. From vacation homes, cabins, beach houses, apartments, condos, house boats, castles, farm stays and everything in between, HomeToGo combines price, destination, dates, and amenities to find the perfect accommodation for any trip worldwide.
tagline: The World’s Largest Selection of Alternative Accommodation

description: Hublo is a digital HR management solution in the healthcare sector. By simplifying the resource planning, replacement, recruiting and staff loyalty in hospitals and nursing homes, Hublo tackles one of the major bottlenecks in today’s healthcare.
tagline: Simplify the daily life of healthcare professionals

description: During their studies at the University of Victoria, Kyle Vucko and Heikal Gani struggled to find a reasonably priced made-to-measure suit. So they decided to start their own business and launched Indochino as an online retailer of custom tailored, premium quality menswear. Headquartered in Victoria, Canada and with production sites in Shanghai, Indochino provides customers with easy-to-use self measurement and online ordering tools for menswear, accessories and wedding wear.
tagline: Made to Measure – Custom Apparel

description: Inspired Go is a Canadian salad delivery company launched in 2019. This DTC service offers customers a variety of gourmet, ready-to-eat salads delivered right to their doors, with new recipes introduced every month. By focusing on using greenhouse-grown lettuce and other high-quality local ingredients, they provide extended shelf life without sacrificing flavour and freshness. Additionally, the use of local greenhouse lettuce saves 99% water compared to traditional field farming, contributing to significant environmental conservation. The company’s purpose is to make healthy eating easy and enjoyable through fresh, inspired meals.
tagline: Inspired Go makes healthy eating easy, sustainable, and affordable for everyone

description: iwoca is transforming small business lending by offering flexible credit facilities to the millions of SMEs that are underserved by banks. Its technology-driven risk platform draws on thousands of data points to make faster, fairer credit decisions, allowing iwoca to lend a small business up to £100,000 within hours.
tagline: Finance built for small businesses to grow

description: The software streamlines the entire legal workflow, from initial client contact and appointment scheduling to the creation of legal documents, enabling law firms to automate key administrative processes and significantly reduce workload. By combining client communication, case intake, and document drafting in one platform, JUPUS sets a new standard in legal operations and addresses one of the industry’s most pressing challenges: the growing shortage of qualified staff.
tagline: Building the first fully automated AI assistant for law firms.

description: Jus Mundi was founded in 2019 in Paris, France. To resolve disputes in the best interest of their clients, arbitration lawyers need to quickly develop a thorough understanding of the relevant case law, statutes, and legal precedents in the respective jurisdiction. Jus Mundi addresses this challenge by offering the most comprehensive and up-to-date global database of case law, treaties & cases, providing detailed insight into comparable cases, clauses, argumentation patterns, and legal precedents across jurisdictions. Customers can access these data via an AI-powered multilingual search engine. In addition, the database encompasses firms and individuals working in arbitration facilitating the search for the experts best suited for each case.
tagline: AI-Powered Search for International Law and Arbitration

description: Klaus is a quality assurance (QA) solution that helps companies drive revenue through excellent customer service. The AI-powered QA platform enables 100% coverage of customer interactions across channels, agents, teams, BPOs, and languages. Thus, Klaus enables companies to uncover the literal needle in the haystack and immediately identify the most critical customer conversations. In 2024, Klaus was acquired by global SaaS giant Zendesk.
tagline: Driving revenue through exceptional customer service

description: Knix is an inclusive direct-to-consumer intimates brand for women and teens. Initially founded and bootstrapped by Joanna Griffiths as a wholesale model, the startup went all digital and DTC in 2016. By focusing on go-to essentials, authentic marketing and product development to solve real-life issues, the inclusive brand is globally recognized as an innovator and disrupter within the apparel space. In 2022, three years since the initital investment, Knix was acquired by global hygiene and health company Essity.
tagline: Created by women for women of all kinds of sizes, shapes and ages

description: Cool, casual, classy – KOIO. Out of the blue Koio created one of the hippest sneaker Direct-To-Consumer brands in New York City and beyond. Eschewing lavish flagship stores and elaborate offline marketing campaigns, KOIO focuses on direct sales via its own online shop, pop-up stores and collaborations with independent artists, actors and international influencers.
tagline: KOIO sneakers dare to go anywhere.

description: Launched in 2008, KupiVIP is an early pioneer in the booming e-commerce sector in Russia. Focused on off-price luxury fashion, the shopping platform purchases discounted second- and first-season apparel and accessories from brand manufacturers. Today, KupiVIP is one of Russia’s largest online retailers for fashion and designer brands.

Laserhub GmbH operates a vertically integrated, manufacturer-independent procurement platform for custom metal parts. Smart algorithms match individual requirements with existing resources of manufacturers in the Laserhub network. Customers include traditional workshops, SMEs and established DAX30 corporations across various industries in Germany, Austria and France.
tagline: Europe’s one-stop shop for metal procurement

description: LemonOne is a B2B photo on demand platform. With its international network of professional photographers and by automating the entire process, LemonOne is able to deliver bespoke high-quality visuals for large-scale clients in industries such as travel, food delivery or real estate at an attractive price.
tagline: Making stock photos redundant

description: The food delivery pioneer Linas Matkasse wants to inspire families to eat good, healthy and varied food, and save time when they need it the most. With home delivered grocery bags, planned by Lina and the menu team, Lina offers nutritionally calculated and tasty meals with both variation and inspiration.

LUMAS/Avenso is a worldwide leading gallery network and online retailer for contemporary photo art. Under its flagship brand LUMAS the company offers curated hand-signed, limited editions of renown and emerging artists to a growing global customer base. In 2013, PE investor EQT acquired a majority stake.
tagline: The Liberation of Art

description: Mambu is a global, cloud-native banking platform and Software-as-a-Service engine that powers banking and lending products for institutions ranging from fintech startups to leading banks within the global finance industry.
tagline: SaaS Composable Banking

description: Online doctors, virtual health & prescriptions – as Canada’s first mover in telemedicine, Maple’s virtual care platform gives access to medical professionals, when and where you need it. Maple’s service allows patients to see a licensed doctor within minutes via mobile app.
tagline: Sustainable healthcare, anytime, anywhere.

description: MedKitDoc improves access to medical care for chronically ill and elderly patients. Combining certified medical devices, a digital health app, and a fast-growing network of local doctors, MedKitDoc enables patient-centered, data-driven, and high-quality remote treatments in Germany.
tagline: Healthcare: easier, smarter, and accessible for all

description: Founded in 2017, Metalshub provides software and data solutions for the metals, mining & recycling industry. The company’s purpose is to drive positive change in the industry by making efficient, digital workflows possible at all levels, by providing transparency for sustainable metals production and by publishing the world’s only transaction-based price indices. Metalshub enables customers to digitize all steps from mine to market to mill in the fields of iron & steel, copper, aluminium, battery metals, scrap and industrial minerals.
tagline: To be the leading supply chain solution for the global metals & mining industry.

description: Digital natives shop mobile first. Mobify’s API-driven web storefront for headless commerce enables retailers to transform their ecommerce platform to a superior customer- and mobile-first experience. Mobify’s Front-end as a Service empowers the agility of a tailor-fit omni-channel solution across desktop, mobile, tablet or native apps. Starting up in Canada as a tech pioneer in mobile commerce, Mobify is meanwhile operating on an international level with enterprise PWAs including multi-brand, multi-region deployments, driving over $1 billion p.a. in Gross Merchandise Value via Front-end as a Service and was acquired by Salesforce, the world’s largest integrated CRM platform, in September 2020.
tagline: Helping businesses to deliver amazing digital experiences to everyone.

description: momox is Europe’s leading re-commerce platform for books, CD/DVD/Blu-rays and second-hand fashion. By offering fast and easy handling to sell and purchase pre-owned goods, momox and its online-shops ubup (fashion) and medimops (media) target a billion-dollar market.
tagline: Re-commerce Leader For Media And Fashion

description: MPB is a data-driven marketplace for trading high-end photography and filmmaking kit. MPB offers the world’s largest curated and verified selection of second-hand photo equipment. All transactions are enabled by MPB’s data-driven vetting and pricing process reflecting current supply and demand. Changing Gear.
tagline: Re-commerce Of High-Quality Photo Gear

description: As digital pioneer changing the eyewear industry since 2004, MyOptique was the first company to sell prescription glasses online. Today, MyOptique Group Ltd is Europe’s leading online retailer for all optical equipment and home to six e-commerce brands selling everything from prescription glasses to contact lenses and sunglasses. In 2016, MyOptique has been acquired by Essilor International, the world leader in ophthalmic optics.
tagline: Reshaping the eyewear industry since 2004

description: With customers in more than 120 countries, Mytheresa is a global boutique for luxury womenswear and numbers among the world’s leading online shops – in a market worth USD 80 billion. In 2014, Mytheresa was successfully sold to Neiman Marcus Group, the world’s largest luxury fashion retailer.
tagline: The Finest Edit In Luxury

description: The onvista Group is the leading platform for financial news and information in Germany. Its full subsidiary onvista Bank GmbH operates as an online broker, while its onvista Media GmbH combines the distribution and marketing of independent information on financial markets. Founded in 1998, onvista announced its IPO in 2000 at Frankfurt Stock Exchange. The issuance of onvista shares was 80 times oversubscribed. After a trade sale to the French online broker Boursorama S.A. in 2007, the German Comdirect Bank AG acquired onvista Group in 2016. “As one of the early digital pioneers, onvista is an impressive example of how providing necessary information can not only be turned into an IPO, but also into a nine-figure success story.” – Paul-Bernhard Kallen (Managing Partner, Acton Capital)
tagline: Germany’s Online Broker Pioneer

description: Paretos was founded in 2020 in Heidelberg, Germany. The company allows retailers, manufacturing companies and logistics providers to improve their operations planning by applying a flexible AI-powered software solution with advanced statistical models to forecast and simulate scenarios. With pareto’s help customers can achieve higher planning accuracy, less out of stock items, lower cost, higher automation and less dependency on single contributors.
tagline: Paretos is the leading AI-based decision intelligence platform to make effective, data-driven decisions across entire organizations.

description: Plantura, the vertically integrated direct-to-consumer brand to make gardening easy and more sustainable, combines a high-quality content platform with innovative gardening consumables.
tagline: Bringing nature home.

description: ArtNight is a curated edutainment platform that hosts creative workshops in nearly 100 cities throughout Germany, Benelux and the UK. ArtNight recruits and trains event hosts on branded formats and sells tickets via its international platform to a local clientele. Developing new verticals like ShakeNight, BakeNight or PlantNight, the startup is creating a growing portfolio of international experience brands. Providing both entertainment and education, ArtNight’s mission is to bring people back together in real life.
tagline: Tackling loneliness, by bringing people together.

description: remberg provides a next-generation maintenance platform that helps industrial companies prevent costly unplanned machine downtime. Built with AI at its core, the mobile and scalable software integrates seamlessly with existing IT infrastructure and enables factory operators to resolve issues faster via smart features like QR code-based equipment access and a built-in AI assistant for real-time troubleshooting. Founded in 2018 in Munich, remberg serves over 150 customers managing more than 1 million assets. With its strong focus on European industry, data security, and local infrastructure, remberg is emerging as a leader in modern CMMS and Enterprise Asset Management.
tagline: AI-powered maintenance platform for Europe’s industrial companies

description: Saas.group was founded in 2017 by Tim Schumacher, Ulrich Essmann and Tobias Schlottke who were joined by a team of experienced entrepreneurs who lead the firm’s global activities. The company acquires, manages and builds horizontal market software businesses in the realm of marketing, development, customer experience and productivity. Using a founder-friendly approach to improve the product and scale the team it is a great new home for bootstrapped or venture financed SaaS companies who are looking to enter into the next phase of growth while maintaining their original identity.
tagline: A Great New Home for Your Business

description: Today, the vast majority of international companies embraces hybrid work. Seatti’s mission is to help companies transition seamlessly into that new way of work and provide a solution that maximizes the benefits for all stakeholders.
tagline: Enabling global enterprises to go hybrid.

description: Sêmeia is the leading French solution for multi-pathology remote patient monitoring. Its data-driven medical device, MedicWise, automatically collects, structures and displays outpatient data and generates highly targeted alerts for clinicians across a range of chronic conditions. Designed in collaboration with healthcare professionals, the platform combines medical expertise and data science to optimise care pathways, helping clinicians more effectively support patients living with chronic conditions, without overburdening care teams.
tagline: Multi-pathology remote patient monitoring at scale.

description: Skribble is the leading Swiss e-signature service, which enables a fully digital document workflow. The company offers all e-signature standards from a single source, and provides the legally appropriate electronic signature for every type of contract.
tagline: E-sign any contract. With anyone. From anywhere.

description: Flunked Algebra again? EdTech Sofatutor provides concise learning content as private tuition for school and university, when grades take a dive. For a monthly fee, the learning platform offers video tutorials, comprehensive worksheets and interactive modules to study for exams and to make complex topics easy to understand.
tagline: Germany’s EdTech pioneer to help students thrive.

description: Cybercrime is among the top threats to companies worldwide, and 9 out of 10 cyber attacks are targeting end users. SoSafe’s automated awareness platform increases resilience and improves cybersecurity culture by assessing risks, training staff and creating secure habits.
tagline: Cyber Security Human Risk Management

description: Stotles unlocks the potential of governments and private sector working together. Teams can find and secure public tenders with less red tape and frustration, through a single platform that integrates into existing tech stacks and workflows.
tagline: Accelerate your public sector sales with Stotles.

description: The Female Company is a direct-to-consumer femcare brand for female health. TFC offers organic, high-quality and sustainably packaged hygiene products, available in a customized subscription model. To accelerate change, TFC uses its online platform and provocative marketing to inform, educate and rise awareness around female intimate care. Its award-winning “Tampon Book” campaign played a central role in reducing the tampon tax in Germany in 2020.
tagline: Shameless products for shameless bodies.

description: Tictail was founded as a free-to-use and DIY e-commerce tool focused on community integration to empower small businesses, like fashion boutiques, craftsmen and emerging designers to establish their local brands all around the world. Tictail expanded from Sweden to the US before being acquired by the global commerce platform Shopify Inc. in November 2018.
tagline: The smart, simple way to build your brand

description: tolingo is a one-of-a-kind, 24/7 online translation network and one of the most renowned translation agencies in Germany, that unites translation expertise, creativity and cutting-edge technology. Through a unique and global pool of over 6,000 specialist translators, tolingo can translate any text at any time with the best translators worldwide.
tagline: Professional Translations into any World Language

description: Significant revenues are lost each year due to poor contract management. Tomorro provides legal and operational teams a platform to manage the entire lifecycle of their contracts assisted by AI to speed-up contract negotiation and execution, automate workflows and increase transparency on contracts for better contract management.
tagline: Collaborative Contract Lifecycle Management

description: The UAM Media Group is the pioneer of local out-of-home advertising and brand marketing in Germany. Starting up in the early 90ies as Edgar Medien AG, UAM offered display marketing and the Edgar-Freecards, advertising postcards and posters adressing young target groups in specific locations like restaurants, bars, cinemas or schools.
tagline: Social since 1992

description: Deep tech pioneer Ultramarin provides quantitative investment strategies based on innovative machine learning (ML) techniques for banks, family offices as well as financial intermediaries.
tagline: Unlocking the potential of ML for investing in capital markets

description: Vialytics is a road condition management SaaS for small and mid-sized municipalities. The company was founded in 2018 by Patrick Glaser, Achim Hoth and Danilo Jovicic-Albrecht in Stuttgart, Germany. The system enables local authorities to efficiently record road conditions via smartphone, analyze damage based on AI and plan measures centrally. With a simple iPhone app, users can take pictures of all local roads while driving which are evaluated by the Vialytics AI-engine with regard to damages, infrastructure like manhole covers and road signs. The web system is then used to record and plan all necessary measures for the maintenance and upkeep of the roads and paths.
tagline: The leading intelligent road management system

description: Smart fleet management: SaaS Scale-up Vimcar offers the seamless integration of commercial vehicles and company cars into digital ecosystems. For a fixed monthly fee, Vimcar’s customers can switch from their handwritten logbook to a digital fleet management via smartphone. Vimcar’s live car data and a set of cloud-based applications offer real-time insight into vehicle activity.
tagline: Redefining fleet management with a simple solution

description: windeln SE is one of the leading online retailers for family products in Europe and operates a successful e-commerce business with products for babies and toddlers in China. The product portfolio includes everything from diapers, baby food, children’s furniture, toys, clothes and strollers to child car seats. In May 2015, Windeln SE has been listed in the Prime Standard of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.
tagline: Online retailer for family products in Europe and to China

description: Yoto is an audio platform for children between 2-12 years. The Yoto Player, its screen-free award-winning smart speaker, safely gives children full control over how and when they listen to audio. Yoto’s mission is to reduce children’s screen-time, inspire creativity and foster imaginations.
tagline: The Screen-Free Audio Player for Children

description: zenjob matches manpower with one-off or regular employments at large and SME businesses, real-time and on-demand. Putting people first, zenjob supports 40,000 workers each month and +2,500 large and SME clients across 10,000+ locations in Germany and Benelux.
tagline: Jobs, smart and easy via app

description: zooplus is Europe’s largest online retailer for pet supplies. As one of the first movers in a massive € 26bn market opportunity, zooplus was founded in 1999 to bring pet shops online. Thanks to an early focus on BI and a sophisticated sales and distribution process, zooplus was able to beat corporate players on their home turf. Today, with customers in 30+ European countries and € 1,5bn revenue p.a., zooplus is the undisputed market leader in the online segment. In 2008, the former startup went public and was added to the SDAX index three years later.
tagline: Europe’s Online Retailer For Pet Supply
